title: SurveyVersionAddlInfo - Data API
description: Represents additional information about a survey version. This information defines the default settings of a survey version. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

EmailSender.description: The organization-wide email address used to send a survey invitation.

EmailTemplateId.description: ID of the email template that's used to send an automated survey invitation.

EngagementContextMetadata.description: The custom metadata created to get the engagement context from the participants.

InvitationSharingRole.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
InvitationSharingRole.description: Indicates the users that share edit access to a survey invitation. Possible values are: InvitationRecordCreator— Owner of the record that's associated with a survey invitation. SurveyOwner
